title: Upstream patches are unavailable for two high-severity audit findings
blocker: Official advisories still list no patched release for node-forge through 1.4.0 (GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv, Nuxt/Nitro/listhen path) or braces through 3.0.3 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, multiple lint/type tooling paths). A successful UI or Python package gate does not make this whole-workspace audit green. Smallest next step: monitor the maintained introducing dependency and actual patched publication; retain the advisories without suppressions or removed tooling. References: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv and https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm. Other audit findings remain in the original report and require individual triage.
